    | where Timestamp between (now() - owners_lookback .. now())

    | extend

        namespace = tostring(['Data']['metadata']['namespace']),

    | extend indirectlyManagedBy = Data.metadata.docusign.org.indirectlyManagedBy

    | extend manager_raw = tostring(Data.metadata.docusign.org.manager)

               target_kind = tostring(relations.target.kind),

targets.query:

let cost_data = RestrictedAzureCostData_EnrollmentLevel
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback_timespan)
| where MeterCategory == "Azure Cosmos DB" and MeterName in ("100 RU/s", "100 Multi-master RU/s")
| where '${Subscription:csv}'  == '.*' or SubscriptionName in (subs)
| where '${ResourceGroup:csv}' == '.*' or ResourceGroup    in (rgs)
| where '${Region:csv}'        == '.*' or ResourceLocation in (regions)
| extend system = tolower(tostring(Tags.system))
| extend CosmosDBName = tolower(tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1]))
| summarize TotalCost = sum(CostInBillingCurrency) by system, CosmosDBName;
let ru_metrics = AzureMetrics
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback_timespan)
| where MetricName == "NormalizedRUConsumption"
| extend CosmosDBName = tolower(tostring(Resource))
| summarize DailyAvg = avg(Average) by CosmosDBName, bin(Timestamp, 1d)
| summarize MaxDailyAvgRU = max(DailyAvg) by CosmosDBName;
let joined = cost_data
| join kind=leftouter (ru_metrics) on CosmosDBName
| extend
    PotentialSavings_50 = iff(isnotnull(MaxDailyAvgRU) and MaxDailyAvgRU < 20, TotalCost * 0.5, real(0)),
    PotentialSavings_30 = iff(isnotnull(MaxDailyAvgRU) and MaxDailyAvgRU < 20, TotalCost * 0.3, real(0)),
    Eligible = iff(isnotnull(MaxDailyAvgRU) and MaxDailyAvgRU < 20, 1, 0);
joined
| summarize
    AnnualizedSystemTotalCost = sum(TotalCost) * scale_factor,
    AnnualizedSystemPotentialSavings_50 = sum(PotentialSavings_50) * scale_factor,
    AnnualizedSystemPotentialSavings_30 = sum(PotentialSavings_30) * scale_factor,
    SystemMaxDailyAvgRU = max(MaxDailyAvgRU),
    TotalCosmosDBs = count(),
    EligibleCosmosDBs = sum(Eligible)
    by system
| order by AnnualizedSystemPotentialSavings_50 desc

targets.query:
let start_date1 = datetime(2025-11-02);
let end_date1 = datetime(2025-11-10);
let target_systems = dynamic(["branding-service", "validation", "agreement=intelligence", "license", "cpp-test-project-23", "sample", "zordon"]);
let target_dbs = dynamic(["msf-sample-tempmongodb-s2-us-dev", "msf-sample-testmongodb-s2-us-dev","msf-sample-tempmongodb-s1-us-dev","msf-sample-testmongodb-s1-us-dev","msf-branding-service-branding-dev-eu1", "msf-branding-service-branding-dev-us", "msf-license-licensesvc-s1-us-truedev", "msf-ai-db1-s2-us-dev", "msf-ai-db1-s1-us-dev", "msf-validation-maindb-dev", "msf-validation-maindb-dev-eu1", "msf-cpp-test-project-23-cppdemocl-s2-eu-dev", "msf-cpp-test-project-23-cppdemocl-s1-eu-dev", "msf-cpp-test-project-23-cppdemocl-s2-us-dev", "msf-cpp-test-project-23-cppdemocl-s1-us-dev", "msf-ai-db1-s1-us-stage", "msf-sample-mongodb-stage", "msf-zordon-plg-main-s1-us-dev", "msf-zordon-plg-main-s2-us-dev","msf-zordon-plg-main-s1-us-stage","msf-zordon-plg-main-s1-us-demo", "msf-zordon-plg-main-s2-us-demo","msf-zordon-plg-main-s1-us-prod","msf-zordon-plg-main-s2-us-prod"]);
let NovDBs = 
    RestrictedAzureCostData_EnrollmentLevel
    | where Timestamp >= start_date1 and Timestamp < end_date1
    | where MeterCategory == "Azure Cosmos DB"
    | extend system = tolower(tostring(Tags.system))
    | where system in (target_systems)
    | extend CosmosDBName = tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1])
    | where CosmosDBName in (target_dbs)
    | where MeterName in ("100 RU/s", "100 Multi-master RU/s")
    | summarize NovCost = sum(CostInBillingCurrency) by CosmosDBName;
let start_date2 = datetime(2025-12-02);
let end_date2 = datetime(2025-12-10);
let DecDBs = 
    RestrictedAzureCostData_EnrollmentLevel
    | where Timestamp >= start_date2 and Timestamp < end_date2
    | where MeterCategory == "Azure Cosmos DB"
    | extend system = tolower(tostring(Tags.system))
    | where system in (target_systems)
    | extend CosmosDBName = tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1])
    | where CosmosDBName in (target_dbs)
    | where MeterName in ("100 RU/s", "100 Multi-master RU/s")
    | summarize DecCost = sum(CostInBillingCurrency) by CosmosDBName;
NovDBs
| join kind=fullouter (DecDBs) on CosmosDBName
| extend NovCost = coalesce(NovCost, 0.0)
| extend DecCost = coalesce(DecCost, 0.0)
| extend Savings = iif(NovCost > DecCost, NovCost - DecCost, 0.0)
| extend Increase = iif(DecCost > NovCost, DecCost - NovCost, 0.0)
| extend SavingPercentage = iff(NovCost > 0, Savings / NovCost * 100, 0.0)
| project CosmosDBName, NovCost, DecCost, Savings, Increase, SavingPercentage
| order by Savings desc, Increase desc, SavingPercentage desc

targets.query:
let owners_lookback = 7d;
let systemOwners = materialize(
    cluster('${OwnersClusterShort}').database('${OwnersDatabase}').DSEvents
    | where Timestamp between (now() - owners_lookback .. now())
    | where FullName == "BackstageConnector/BackstageServiceCatalog"
    | extend 
        ['kind'] = tolower(tostring(['Data']['kind'])),
        namespace = tostring(['Data']['metadata']['namespace']),
        name = tolower(tostring(Data.metadata.name))
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, Data) by ['kind'], namespace, name
    | extend indirectlyManagedBy = Data.metadata.docusign.org.indirectlyManagedBy
    | extend im_length = array_length(indirectlyManagedBy)
    | extend manager_raw = tostring(Data.metadata.docusign.org.manager)
    | extend VP = iff(im_length >= 3, tostring(indirectlyManagedBy[im_length - 3]), manager_raw)
    | extend VP_Name = replace_string(VP, "user:", "")
    | project ['kind'], namespace, name, manager = manager_raw, relations = Data.relations, VP_Name
    | mv-apply relations on (
        extend type = tostring(relations.type),
               target_kind = tostring(relations.target.kind),
               target_name = tolower(tostring(relations.target.name))
        | where target_kind == 'system' and type == 'ownerOf'
        | project system = target_name
    )
);
let start_date1 = datetime(2025-06-01);
let end_date1 = datetime(2025-07-01);
let JuneSystems = 
    RestrictedAzureCostData_EnrollmentLevel
    | where Timestamp >= start_date1 and Timestamp < end_date1
    | where MeterCategory == "Azure Cosmos DB"
    | extend system = tolower(tostring(Tags.system))
    | where MeterName in ("100 RU/s", "100 Multi-master RU/s")
    | summarize JuneCost = sum(CostInBillingCurrency) by system;
let Last30DSystems = 
    RestrictedAzureCostData_EnrollmentLevel
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where MeterCategory == "Azure Cosmos DB"
    | extend system = tolower(tostring(Tags.system))
    | where MeterName in ("100 RU/s", "100 Multi-master RU/s")
    | summarize Last30DCost = sum(CostInBillingCurrency) by system;
JuneSystems
| join kind=fullouter (Last30DSystems) on system
| extend JuneCost = coalesce(JuneCost, 0.0)
| extend Last30DCost = coalesce(Last30DCost, 0.0)
| extend Savings = iif(JuneCost > Last30DCost, JuneCost - Last30DCost, 0.0)
| extend Increase = iif(Last30DCost > JuneCost, Last30DCost - JuneCost, 0.0)
| where isnotempty(system)
| lookup kind=leftouter (systemOwners | project system, VP_Name) on system
| extend VP_Name = coalesce(VP_Name, '(no VP attribution)')
| project system, VP_Name, JuneCost, Last30DCost, Savings, Increase
| order by Savings desc, Increase desc
